## What this lands

- **`web/tests/e2e/capstone-advocate.spec.ts`** — the A1–A4 journey battery,
  walked cold from `/` once per {390, 1440 px} × {JS on, JS off} cell. Every
  journey resolves its targets from the served site itself (the A–Z directory
  is the named no-JS place-lookup equivalent; breadcrumbs supply the print
  ancestor; the research queue supplies the task) — nothing fixture-specific
  is hard-coded, so the identical spec runs against the promoted origin.
  A1: hero + header typeahead → Oklahoma City dossier in ≤3 clicks, plus the
  no-JS `GET` form contract and the A–Z fallback. A2: sourced values or typed
  absences ("records" wording, source block + share, next decisions, stamps).
  A3: dossier → print route → council brief with locator, permalink, terms,
  runhead. A4: documents-to-bring, *What we don't know* → queue →
  records-request task → never-sent downloadable `.draft.txt`.
- **`web/playwright.capstone.config.ts`** — the dedicated four-project runner
  (`capstone-1440-js`, `capstone-390-js`, `capstone-1440-nojs`,
  `capstone-390-nojs`). `SIG_CAPSTONE_BASE_URL=<promoted-origin>` skips the
  preview server and points the battery at the promoted release — a
  fixture/preview pass is never reported as a live/public pass.
- **`ops/src/ops/capstone_advocate.py` + `sig-ops capstone-advocate`** — the
  `sig.capstone-advocate/1` leg declaration: `journeys-fixture` and

- **`docs/build/reports/p37.68a-capstone/`** — `PACKET.md` + `packet.json`
